schema.regionPolicy: Groups share boundary nodes; region passes never duplicate joints. Dense facial sides honor the source mirror convention.

face.authority: Five editable facial slots; body-detector eye coordinates remain raw evidence, not competing controls.

landmarkExtension.convention: 68-point detector ordering; anatomical anchors map explicitly, not by image x

schema.proportions: character-specific; no mannequin dimensions are canonical

extensions.policy: add namespaced profiles/points; retain unknown JSON fields; no silent dropping

schema.ground: separate user guide or silhouette estimate, not skeletal root and not proven foot contact

manifest.scope: Stage 1: source inventory, clean independent-figure extraction, fixed motion-envelope tracks, provisional metadata and visual verification.

coordinate_convention.panel_pixels: origin at isolated panel top-left; x right; y down; source y retained
coordinate_convention.root_floor_estimate: provisional isolated-silhouette estimate, not AdventureBody2D tracking
coordinate_convention.future_canonical_note: Adventure Studio floor-relative coordinates and anatomical left/right remain the intended later canonical bridge.

source_videos.action_plain: Energetic dance with knee lifts and changing arm silhouettes
source_videos.quality_notes: Clear silhouettes and useful arm/leg extremes; three performances vary independently and a source watermark is present.
source_videos.caution: Treat panels as related pose variations, not synchronized camera views.

source_videos.action_plain: Crouch, recoil, side lean and compressed body poses
source_videos.quality_notes: Useful deep crouch and hidden-limb stress cases; the generated anatomy and timing vary strongly across panels; watermark present.
source_videos.caution: Use primarily to expose solver and occlusion failures, not to define proportions.

source_videos.action_plain: Action lunge, reach/strike and wide stance
source_videos.quality_notes: Strong action silhouettes and reach extremes; limbs approach crop edges and the panel choreography is not matched; watermark present.
source_videos.caution: Useful for lunges and reaches, but panel view identity changes during the action.

source_videos.action_plain: Progressive forward bend ending in a hanging fold
source_videos.quality_notes: Clean silhouettes and highly useful spine/neck evidence; lower source resolution but stable background and strong semantic synchronization.
source_videos.caution: A one-way transition that ends folded; not a closed loop.

source_videos.action_plain: Backward arch followed by a controlled return
source_videos.quality_notes: High-resolution clean source, strong synchronization and a near-return to the opening pose.
source_videos.caution: Extreme torso extension requires corrective art or a more flexible spine representation.

source_videos.action_plain: Rhythmic stepping, crossing and arm sway
source_videos.quality_notes: High-resolution and rhythmically useful; silhouettes remain legible but root travel and pose variation make it a motion reference rather than a clean module source.
source_videos.caution: Does not return cleanly to its starting state; root movement is not guaranteed to be gameplay locomotion.

source_videos.quality_notes: Clear extreme leg articulation and useful support-foot evidence; lower source resolution but strong synchronization.
source_videos.caution: Raised-leg anatomy and pelvis shape vary between panels; use pose evidence rather than literal proportion truth.

source_videos.action_plain: Repeated high knee lift and return
source_videos.quality_notes: Clear lower-body calibration and support-foot evidence with strong semantic synchronization.
source_videos.caution: Lifted-foot orientation and support posture differ between panels; requires explicit contact states.

source_videos.action_plain: Turn/weight shift into single-leg balance and footstand
source_videos.quality_notes: Strong balance, pelvis-tilt and foot-contact evidence; clean blue background and useful view-transition material.
source_videos.caution: Ends in a different pose; the panels are not calibrated stages of one exact turn.

source_videos.action_plain: Upper-body arm-pose vocabulary with nearly fixed feet
source_videos.quality_notes: Very useful isolated arm vocabulary and stable lower body; hands/fingers are not production-clean.
source_videos.caution: Panels show parallel arm variations rather than temporally matched views.

source_videos.action_plain: Light turn/hop with arm sway and return toward neutral
source_videos.quality_notes: Clean silhouettes and useful facing/weight-transfer evidence; panel timing is mixed.
source_videos.caution: Use as transition evidence rather than exact view correspondence.

source_videos.action_plain: Two-view turn into horizontal arm extension
source_videos.quality_notes: Useful two-view shoulder-height reach and view-switch evidence; source watermark present.
source_videos.caution: Only two panels; the end poses are related but not exact equivalents and the clip does not return.

libraryStarterPass.scope: Three additional corpus-panel videos; full draft tracking, selected 2D guide corrections and visibility decisions; no application redesign.
libraryStarterPass.normalization: Checked crown/foot guides establish fixed uniform comparison scale only. No per-frame stretching or physical body-dimension claim.
libraryStarterPass.verificationMeaning: UI verified scopes are assistant-reviewed source-resolution 2D guide positions or explicit hidden states. They are not owner acceptance, whole-frame approval or proof of canonical mannequin compatibility.
libraryStarterPass.headDirectionLimitation: Current UI stores one coarse frame view. Separate head observations are preserved in entry.extensions.libraryStarterPass.headOrientation and reference tags; no separate head/torso UI was added.
libraryStarterPass.environment: Unchanged application in isolated Chromium document; normal file navigation blocked; native IndexedDB unavailable. Portable backups used. No storage or detector mocking.
libraryStarterPass.originalArtwork: Original encoded media retained; rendered cleanup is derived. No mannequin-rigger changes, separate limb artwork extraction or model training.
libraryStarterPass.cleanup: Application chroma key and despill applied to all 299 new samples. Selected frames visually inspected. No manual brush strokes or recoloring were needed in this bounded pass; no pixel-perfect matte certification.

documentation.purpose: Complete and verify the existing corpus, then reuse its reviewed anatomical configurations for compatible character identities.
documentation.authority: Original pixels and original corpus metadata are retained. Automatic observations are drafts, not human verification.
documentation.views: Two panes are a working comparison, not a two-clip library limit. Equal playback progress does not establish synchronized performances.
documentation.learning: Explicit saved reference retrieval and local correction-assisted tracking. No automatic model training.
documentation.normalization: A fixed per-clip uniform display transform, never per-frame stretching or a proven anatomical measurement.

schema.regionPolicy: Groups share boundary nodes; region passes never duplicate joints. Dense facial sides honor the source mirror convention.

face.authority: Five editable facial slots; body-detector eye coordinates remain raw evidence, not competing controls.

landmarkExtension.convention: 68-point detector ordering; anatomical anchors map explicitly, not by image x

extensions.policy: add namespaced profiles/points; retain unknown JSON fields; no silent dropping
